description.text: Why SUT? 1. Situated in Shenyang—— a key modern city in the northeast; 2. Engineering oriented comprehensive university; 3. Pure English taught programs; 4. Specifically international students' accommodation with complete facilities; 5. Good climate with distinctively four seasons; 6. Convenient shopping environment. MainCourses TheoreticalMechanics，Mechanicsof Materials，Structural Mechanics，Civil Engineering DrawingandCAD，CivilEngineeringMaterials，Concrete Structure Design Basic Principle，DesignPrinciplesofSteelStructure，CivilEngineeringConstruction，SoilMechanics&Substructure，CivilEngineeringSurveying，Earthquake Resistanceof Engineering Structure，Building Construction,Bridge Construction. Multi-media classroom Study Duration 2.5 years Degree Awarded Students who are eligible to obtain a master's degree and graduate diploma must successfully complete the prescribed credits delivered by Major Cultivation Program and pass the graduate dissertation.

duration.text: The Civil Engineering at Shenyang University of Technology is a 2.5 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Passport first page2.Passport empty visa page3.Notarized University graduation certificate and the Chinese translation4. Notarized University transcript and the Chinese translation5.Two reference letters6.Study plan7.English competence certificate8.Medical report9.Non-criminal record certificate10.Self-introduction video in English11.Applicant who used to study or live in China needs to provide other documents based on the actual situation12. requirements.text: 1. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport with good health.2. Applicants should own bachelor degree in concerned subjects or above.3.Applicants for a master's degree should have a bachelor's degree or equivalent, have excellent academic records, and be under the age of 35.
